branch.name: cursor/recording-workflow-7ab1
branch.mock_result: 90 passed on 2026-11-06, including existing bridge, clip-note, and dataset tests. No Ableton process.

sources.title: Cycling '74 Live Object Model index
sources.version_stamp: This document refers to Ableton Live version 12.4.5
sources.context: Max for Live object model. It is the published member list. It is not an Ableton Python Remote Script manual, and a listed member is not an installed MCP command.

sources.title: Ableton Live 12 manual, Recording New Clips
sources.version_stamp: Live 12 manual, no patch number on the page
sources.context: Product behavior. Not an API member list.

sources.title: Max 5 and Max 7 Live Object Model, Track.current_monitoring_state
sources.version_stamp: Max 7 / older Live, not the 12.4.5 index
sources.context: Documents 0=In, 1=Auto, 2=Off. The Live 12.4.5 Track page text captured on the same day did not include this member.

sources.title: structure-void Live 12 Python runtime stubs
sources.version_stamp: community extraction, not an Ableton publication
sources.context: Used only where it adds or conflicts with the Max LOM. Not treated as the documented LOM.

rows.meaning: 1 = the Arrangement Record button is on.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: set_arrangement_record; also read on get_session_info and get_recording_state
rows.tests: mock: overlap at playhead refuses with zero writes; clear playhead sets the flag; idempotent when already set
rows.caveat: Does not start or stop playback. Manual: whether recording starts immediately depends on Start Playback with Record. Overwrite guard looks at arrangement clips covering current_song_time on armed tracks.

rows.meaning: Official Max text: 'The state of the Session Overdub button.' Non-official Python stub: 'Get/Set the session record state.'
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: set_session_record writes this property. The command name says session record. That name is not settled by the official sentence.
rows.tests: mock: refuses when an armed track's selected scene or playing slot has a clip; allow_overwrite writes; idempotent
rows.live_check: required before trusting the label. Confirm which transport button moves.
rows.caveat: Do not describe this as proven Session Record. session_record_status is the read-only field the Max page ties to the Session Record button.

rows.meaning: Official: reflects the Session Record button. Not settable. Values 0 off, 1 on, 2 transition are from the non-official Python enum, not from the Max page text.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: get_recording_state reads it and maps 0/1/2 only as labels
rows.live_check: pending, including whether 0/1/2 match Live 12 Suite
rows.caveat: Read-only. The integer legend is not in the Max page captured here.

rows.meaning: Starts recording in the selected slot or the next empty slot if the track is armed. Optional length in beats. Calling it while recording stops recording and starts playback.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: not called
rows.caveat: Not an idempotent setter. Target slot is implicit. A second call has a playback side effect. Left unused on purpose.

rows.feature: Record into one empty Session slot
rows.meaning: Fires a clip, or the stop button. Starts recording if the slot is empty and the track is armed. A passed record_length records that many beats. The page says this raises if the slot owns a clip when record_length is passed.
rows.installed_1_7_1: fire_clip calls fire with no length and no empty-slot guard
rows.branch: record_empty_slot: refuses occupied or already recording slots, refuses unarmed fire, optional length, does not set session_record
rows.tests: mock: occupied slot does not fire or arm; unarmed arm=false does not fire; length 4 calls fire(4.0); failed fire restores arm
rows.live_check: pending: only that slot records; length ends the take; quantization may delay the punch
rows.caveat: Reply means fire() returned, not that audio was captured. Not a global record-N-bars operation.

rows.meaning: MIDI Arrangement Overdub button.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: set_arrangement_overdub
rows.tests: mock sets the flag and leaves record_mode false
rows.caveat: Does not start recording. Manual: arrangement overdub applies to MIDI, not as an audio-replace mode.

rows.meaning: Official Max text also says MIDI Arrangement Overdub. Non-official Python stub says it is a legacy alias of session record and does not start playback. The two texts disagree.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: read in get_recording_state as legacy_overdub; not written
rows.tests: not written by any new command
rows.live_check: do not set until the conflict is resolved on Live 12 Suite
rows.caveat: Not established which button this moves on Live 12 Suite.

rows.meaning: 0 none, 1 one bar, 2 two bars, 3 four bars. Not settable on this page.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: reported by get_recording_state; no setter
rows.tests: mock reads 1 as 1_bar and does not change the value
rows.live_check: confirm the index map on this Live 12 Suite; change count-in in Live's own preferences
rows.caveat: A writable count-in was on the wish list. The documented API does not offer a setter. Song.is_counting_in is also get/observe only.

rows.meaning: Metronome enabled.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: read only inside get_recording_state
rows.caveat: Not built. Count-in is silent unless the metronome is already on. Candidate for a later explicit setter, not part of this branch.

rows.meaning: start_playing starts from the insert marker. stop_playing stops playback.
rows.installed_1_7_1: start_playback, stop_playback. is_playing is read in get_session_info.
rows.branch: unchanged. New stop commands do not call stop_playing.
rows.caveat: is_playing is documented settable. The installed command uses start_playing/stop_playing, not assignment.

rows.meaning: Punch-in enables recording when playback hits the loop start. Punch-out disables it at loop end.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: not implemented
rows.caveat: Atomic flags. Not a composite auto-punch workflow. Not in this branch.

rows.access: arm get set observe; can_be_armed get
rows.meaning: arm is 1 when armed. Not on return or main tracks. can_be_armed is 0 for return and main. Exclusive arm is Song.exclusive_arm, get only.
rows.installed_1_7_1: read in get_track_info via _safe_arm at line 609 of the 1.7.1 file. No setter.
rows.branch: set_track_arm explicit bool. Refuses frozen and tracks that cannot be armed.
rows.tests: mock: bad types and bad index do not write; group does not write; same value does not write
rows.live_check: pending, including exclusive-arm disarming other tracks
rows.caveat: The wish list treated arm as missing. The read existed. The write did not. exclusive_arm cannot be set from the documented API.

rows.access: get set observe on legacy Max LOM
rows.meaning: Legacy pages: 0=In, 1=Auto, 2=Off, not on return or main. The Live 12.4.5 Track page text captured on 2026-11-06 did not list this member.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: set_track_monitoring writes 0/1/2 for in/auto/off
rows.tests: mock rejects unknown names with no write; Off writes 2
rows.live_check: required on Live 12 Suite. The integer map is from older official docs.
rows.caveat: Not established from the 12.4.5 page alone. Non-official Python stubs also list the property, without restating the integers in the snippet used here.

rows.access: current get set observe; available get observe
rows.meaning: Each value has display_name and identifier. Set only to a value from the available list. MIDI and audio tracks only.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: set_track_input_routing and prepare_track. Match display_name. Bad channel restores the previous type.
rows.tests: mock: unknown type does not write and lists options; bad channel restores Ext. In
rows.live_check: pending with names from get_track_mixer_state on that track
rows.caveat: Output routing is the same shape and is read, not set. Legacy pages also have string current_input_routing; this branch uses the routing objects.

rows.access: parameters get, then DeviceParameter.value get set; mute and solo get set observe
rows.meaning: Volume, pan, and sends are DeviceParameter values between their own min and max, not dB. Solo from the API bypasses exclusive solo. Mute is not on the main track. Sends: one per return.
rows.installed_1_7_1: volume, pan, mute, solo read in get_track_info. No setters. Sends appear in the session snapshot serializer, not as a command.
rows.branch: set_track_volume, set_track_panning, set_track_send, set_track_mute, set_track_solo, prepare_track
rows.tests: mock: volume 1.2 and NaN pan and send index 4 do not write; 0.5 writes once
rows.live_check: pending. Confirm 0.85 is the unity the user expects by ear or by value_string, not by assuming dB.
rows.caveat: DeviceParameter.value_string is get only (str_for_value exists). display_value is get set on the parameter page. This branch sets value, not display_value.

rows.feature: Create MIDI or audio track, rename, color
rows.access: functions; name and color get set observe
rows.meaning: create_* index -1 appends. color is 0x00rrggbb and snaps to the chooser.
rows.installed_1_7_1: create_midi_track, create_audio_track, set_track_name. No color command.
rows.branch: unchanged, plus optional name inside prepare_track
rows.tests: existing create tests not expanded; prepare name covered
rows.live_check: create and rename already used; color not implemented
rows.caveat: Color is a documented setter and is not in this branch. Return tracks have create_return_track; not wrapped.

rows.meaning: Group membership can be read. The Song and Track pages reviewed do not list a group-creation or move-track function.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: record and stop refuse foldable group slots
rows.caveat: Do not plan a group or reorder command until a member is found. Duplicate_track and delete_track exist and are destructive; they are not reorder.

rows.member: Device.parameters, DeviceParameter.value, min, max, name, is_quantized, value_items
rows.access: parameters get; value get set; value_items get
rows.meaning: Device page: only automatable parameters are accessible.
rows.installed_1_7_1: get_device_parameters and set_device_parameter. Snapshot stores name, value, min, max, is_enabled, is_quantized, value_string.
rows.branch: unchanged
rows.caveat: A plug-in that exposes no automatable parameters can show only Device On. That matches the reported Analog Lab V read.

rows.access: presets get observe; index get set observe
rows.meaning: Live's list of the plug-in's presets, and the selected index.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command. load_instrument_or_effect loads a browser URI.
rows.branch: not implemented
rows.live_check: not run. Do not assume Analog Lab's internal browser is this list.
rows.caveat: Loading a device is not searching presets inside it. selected_preset_index is a real setter candidate. It is not Sound Character tags and it is not AU-vendor UI.

rows.feature: Insert a native Live device by name
rows.meaning: Native devices only. Max for Live devices and plug-ins are not supported by this function.
rows.installed_1_7_1: load_instrument_or_effect / load_browser_item by URI, which can load browser items including plug-ins
rows.branch: not added
rows.caveat: A different path from the browser loader. Not a substitute for AU preset search.

rows.member: Application.browser children name, uri, is_device, is_loadable
rows.access: not a class in the 12.4.5 LOM index captured here
rows.meaning: The index page captured on 2026-11-06 does not list a Browser class. The Remote Script reads the control-surface browser object directly.
rows.installed_1_7_1: get_browser_tree and get_browser_items_at_path. Item dict is name, is_folder, is_device, is_loadable, uri. Commit 9dddc7b lines 2564-2579. No tag field is read.
rows.branch: unchanged
rows.tests: bridge tests cover tree shape, not tags
rows.live_check: a read-only probe was already done on the installed session; this survey did not repeat it
rows.caveat: Reported probe: results were name, uri, is_folder, is_device, is_loadable, and no tags. That matches the serializer. Sound Character tags and filters are not established from the docs reviewed.

rows.meaning: No tag, character, or filter member was in the LOM pages reviewed.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no field in the browser serializer
rows.branch: not implemented
rows.live_check: probe reported no tags; not re-run here
rows.caveat: Do not build a tag filter on the current browser payload. Loading a hit is not searching inside the device.

rows.meaning: Notes include pitch, start, duration, velocity, mute, and on the extended calls probability and velocity_deviation.
rows.installed_1_7_1: get_clip_notes, add_notes_to_clip, clear_notes_from_clip. Extended fields are best-effort in the reader. The writer sends pitch, time, duration, velocity, mute.
rows.branch: unchanged
rows.caveat: apply_note_modifications, note ids, and probability are documented and not wrapped as their own commands. That is a gap, not a missing API.

rows.access: functions; recording quantization get set observe
rows.meaning: quantize takes a grid and an amount. midi_recording_quantization is the transport record-quantization value, 0 none through 8 = 1/32.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: not implemented
rows.caveat: Recording quantization and clip quantize are different operations. Neither is in this branch.

rows.feature: Start and end markers and loop
rows.meaning: Markers are in beats, independent of loop. End cannot be set before start; start cannot be set behind end. Loop points are beats if MIDI or warped, seconds if unwarped. Unwarped audio cannot loop.
rows.installed_1_7_1: loop fields are in the snapshot serializer. No marker command. get_arrangement_clips used start_time/end_time, which are not the markers.
rows.branch: get_clip_region and set_clip_region. Does not call crop.
rows.tests: mock: inverted markers do not write; loop shrinks before the end marker; a failed looping write restores markers; crop is never called
rows.live_check: pending on a warped and an unwarped audio clip
rows.caveat: Clip.start_time and Clip.end_time are get/observe only. Setting them is not how you move or trim. Arrangement start_time is the clip's arrangement offset, and it is read-only.

rows.access: gain get set observe, 0.0 to 1.0; display string get
rows.meaning: Audio clips only.
rows.installed_1_7_1: gain is stored in the snapshot serializer if present. No setter command.
rows.branch: not a setter
rows.caveat: Not implemented. gain is not dB; gain_display_string is the dB text and is read-only.

rows.feature: Warp switch, mode, and warp markers
rows.member: Clip.warping, Clip.warp_mode, Clip.warp_markers, Clip.add_warp_marker, Clip.move_warp_marker, Clip.remove_warp_marker
rows.access: warping and warp_mode get set; warp_markers get observe; marker edits are functions
rows.meaning: warp_markers get is available since Live 11. The last marker is hidden. add_warp_marker has BPM and sample-time constraints. The page says setting warping is deferred internally.
rows.installed_1_7_1: warp_mode and warp markers are read into the snapshot when present. No edit command.
rows.branch: warping is read on get_clip_region so marker units can be described. No warp edits.
rows.caveat: Writing warp markers changes timing. Not in this branch. Read-back of markers is a reasonable later step before any write.

rows.meaning: The Clip page captured on 2026-11-06 has no fade_in, fade_out, or fade curve member.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: not implemented
rows.caveat: Do not call this unsupported. It was not in the pages reviewed.

rows.meaning: Removes audio outside the loop, or outside the markers if not looped.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: explicitly not called
rows.caveat: Destructive. Out of scope.

rows.meaning: Read-only path. Creating a new clip from a file is ClipSlot.create_audio_clip(path), Live 12.0.5+.
rows.installed_1_7_1: create_audio_clip imports a new file into an empty slot. It does not replace an existing clip's file.
rows.branch: set_clip_region does not take a path
rows.caveat: No documented setter for swapping the file under an existing clip was in the pages reviewed.

rows.meaning: Fires every slot in the scene. Can start recording on armed empty tracks inside a group if that preference is on.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no scene command. fire_clip fires one slot.
rows.branch: not implemented. Selected scene is only read as a safety check for session record.
rows.caveat: Atomic and useful. Not the same as record_empty_slot. Not in this branch.

rows.meaning: Song value 0 is None, then 8 bars down to 1/32. ClipSlot.fire can override quantization for that call.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: not set. record_empty_slot does not pass launch_quantization, so Live's current setting applies.
rows.live_check: the delay before a fired slot records depends on this and was not measured
rows.caveat: This is why a command reply is not a real-time punch. A later setter should be explicit, not hidden inside record.

rows.access: cue_points get; set_or_delete_cue function; name get set; time get; jump function
rows.meaning: set_or_delete_cue toggles a cue at the current arrangement time. jump moves playback to that locator. time is not settable.
rows.installed_1_7_1: create_locator moves the playhead, calls set_or_delete_cue, renames, then restores the playhead. Cue points are in the snapshot. No jump command.
rows.branch: unchanged
rows.live_check: create_locator already in use; jump not wrapped
rows.caveat: Creating a locator is not the same as seeking. CuePoint.jump is the documented seek. Song.current_song_time is get set and is already wrapped as set_arrangement_time.

rows.meaning: Arrangement start_time is the offset in the arrangement and is read-only on this page. end_time is also get/observe.
rows.installed_1_7_1: get_arrangement_clips reads start_time and end_time. duplicate_session_clip_to_arrangement copies a session clip to a beat.
rows.branch: get_arrangement_clips also reads markers. No move command.
rows.live_check: not established as a setter from the docs reviewed
rows.caveat: Duplicate is not move. A 'move section' command would be a composite and is not one documented call.

rows.member: Track.take_lanes, Track.create_take_lane, TakeLane.arrangement_clips, TakeLane.name, TakeLane.create_audio_clip, TakeLane.create_midi_clip
rows.access: list get; create_take_lane function; lane name get set; create clip functions
rows.meaning: Lanes hold arrangement clips for comping. The pages reviewed do not list a comp or copy-to-main function.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: not implemented
rows.caveat: Listing lanes is atomic. Comping a section is not established as one call. Not in this branch.

rows.meaning: Undo or redo the last operation.
rows.installed_1_7_1: no command
rows.branch: not implemented. Commands do not call undo to roll back a take.
rows.tests: invalid input is rejected before writes, which is not the same as undo
rows.caveat: One undo step per Live operation, not a batch transaction. begin_undo_step appears only in the non-official Python stub and is not in the Max Song page captured here.

rows.feature: When a command finishes versus when audio starts
rows.access: control surface scheduling, then the LOM call
rows.meaning: Remote Script work is posted to Live's main thread. fire() can wait for launch quantization. The socket reply is sent when the call returns.
rows.installed_1_7_1: modifying commands already use schedule_message. Reads such as get_session_info do not.
rows.branch: every new command uses schedule_message. Replies say they are not a real-time acknowledgement.
rows.tests: mock asserts the handler runs inside schedule_message, and directly if schedule_message raises AssertionError
rows.live_check: not measured. Do not claim sample-accurate or real-time response.
rows.caveat: prepare_track is one round trip, which removes extra socket trips. It does not remove quantization or audio-device latency.
